task.title: Prerequisites
task.shortdesc: You will need to obtain the following files from your Apttus contact.

context.p: You will need to obtain the following files from your Apttus contact.

ul.li: WindowsOfficeAddInsLauncher.exe – The add-in utility required for completing Windows installation

step.cmd: Save the manifest file Apttus.XAuthor.AppManifest.xml to a location on your computer. Make a note of the file path.
Enter the complete file path that points to the manifest file on your system (for example, C:\OfficeManifest\Apttus.XAuthor.AppManifest.xml) and press Enter.
Open Microsoft Word and go to File > Options > Trust Center > Trust Center Settings > Trust Add-in Catalogs.
Highlight the Office manifest file catalog entry and click Remove.
Close all open Microsoft Word instances.
Open Microsoft Word and go to File > Options > Trust Center > Trust Center Settings > Trust Add-in Catalogs.
In the Category Url field, add the appropriate catalog path for your add-in, make sure Show in Menu is checked, and click OK.
Open Microsoft Word and go to Insert > My Add-ins > X-Author Contracts to run the add-in.
